scope: Test-only fixture construction change in tests/storage_lifecycle_physical.py::PhysicalHarness.physical_loose_packed_and_pin. Acceptance assertions and post-GC behavior left intact. Static diff review only; no native run claimed here.

findings.detail: Diff is test-only: git show --stat reports only tests/storage_lifecycle_physical.py (+24/-1). No src/product changes, no SQL root deletion, no fabricated receipts.

Offline 'git update-ref -d refs/heads/temporary' replaced by supported Smart-HTTP delete 'git push origin :refs/heads/temporary'. Removes the unsupported path that bypassed the durable ref-index projection and left a stale root; source GC retention was correctly protecting that stale projection.

Real delivery barrier added: before packing waits for create projection deleted=false and ref-index outbox undelivered count=0; after delete waits projection deleted=true, asserts no live root (NOT deleted AND oid IS NOT NULL), and waits ref-index delivery drain before stopping. Fixture faithful to supported semantics.

Scheduler deferred via ROOTYARD_STORAGE_MAINTENANCE=false (genuinely parsed setting, src/storage_lifecycle/models.rs:32-35) during fixture construction, restored to 'true' only at acceptance phase before self.start() and pin/GC assertions. Prevents premature GC racing fixture; does not weaken acceptance.

Acceptance assertions unchanged vs parent: loose path absence, cat-file -e packed (pre-GC), fsck --unreachable contains packed, CI pin POST, tombstone->deleted plus cat-file -e returncode!=0 for loose/packed, base+retained preserved, fetch, fsck --full --strict; returned dict identical.

No masking of product defects: stale-projection retention is source behavior already exercised by the approved enospc case, not suppressed here. Change aligns fixture with supported delete; no assertion loosened, removed, or fabricated.

reason: Commit ed8d074 strictly repairs fixture construction in physical_loose_packed_and_pin. The prior offline update-ref deletion was an unsupported operation that left a stale durable ref-index projection, so source GC retention correctly kept the packed object and the test precondition mismatched supported product behavior. Product/GC assertions and the return contract are unchanged; no source edits, no SQL root deletion, no fabricated receipts. Consistent with the already-approved 47-ENOSPC fixture pattern.
